rules.name: A
rules.text: Bet our favourite when it is the away team and the bookmaker's chance for it (margin taken out) is at least 1 point higher than ours.
rules.found: Checked on closing moneylines with the EPA model, each week predicted only from earlier weeks: this season to week 11, 27 bets, 24 won, +24%; last season 43 bets, +9.8%. Low prices (about 1.40), so one loss costs a lot. On the page for testing only.

rules.name: H
rules.text: Bet the home team on the moneyline when our win chance for it is above 50% and the gap (ours minus the bookmaker's, margin taken out) is -12 points or lower, as the table shows them. Not in week 1, when our numbers are still only last season's.
rules.found: Checked on closing moneylines with the EPA model, each week predicted only from earlier weeks, week 1 left out: this season weeks 2-11, 12 bets, 11 won, +2.2 units (+18%); last season 19 bets, 14 won, -1.8 units (-9%). Very low prices (about 1.25-1.30), so one loss wipes out three or four wins. On the page for testing only.

rules.name: B1
rules.text: Bet the away team on the moneyline when our win chance for the home team is above 50% and the home gap (ours minus the bookmaker's, margin taken out) is above +10.1 points, as the table shows them: the bookmaker likes the home side far less than we do.
rules.found: Checked on closing moneylines: this season to 23 November 17 bets, 13 won, +6.8 units (+40%), average price 1.78; last season 69 bets, 37 won, -8.0 units (-12%). On the page for testing only.

rules.name: B2
rules.text: Bet the home team on the moneyline when our win chance for the away team is above 50% and the away gap (ours minus the bookmaker's, margin taken out) is above +12.1 points, as the table shows them: the bookmaker likes the away side far less than we do.
rules.found: Checked on closing moneylines: this season to 23 November 10 bets, 9 won, +4.2 units (+42%), average price 1.58; last season 45 bets, 25 won, -8.4 units (-19%). On the page for testing only.

rules.name: R1
rules.text: Bet the home team to win in regulation (60 minutes) when our chance for it, overtime included, is above 50% and the gap (ours minus the bookmaker's, margin taken out) is below -6 points, as the table shows them.
rules.found: Picked from this season's games: to 23 November 30 bets, 23 won in regulation. Settled at the bookmaker's estimated 60-minute price (from the moneyline, see below): about +29% this season, against +65% at our own odds. The same games on the moneyline lost last season (about -14%). On the page for testing only.

rules.name: R2
rules.text: Bet the away team to win in regulation (60 minutes) when our chance for it, overtime included, is above 50% and the gap (ours minus the bookmaker's, margin taken out) is below +2 points, as the table shows them.
rules.found: Picked from this season's games: to 23 November 89 bets, 53 won in regulation. Settled at the bookmaker's estimated 60-minute price (from the moneyline, see below): about +21% this season, against +37% at our own odds. On the moneyline these games won this season (about +7%) and lost last season (about -6%). On the page for testing only.

rule.name: T
rule.text: Back the worse-ranked player when the bookmaker's odds are at or above our tennis dashboard's fair odds and at most 3.25. Men and women alike. Picks and results come from the tennis dashboard (czakopeti/tennis), which updates at about 6:45, 8:45, 10:45 and 18:45 Budapest time.
rule.found: On the dashboard's history from 19 August to 9 November: 241 bets, 116 won, +35.2 units (+14.6%), average odds 2.40; from 1 October 123 bets, +6.3 units (+5.1%).
rule.backtest: 241 bets, 116 won, +35.2 units (+14.6%), dashboard history 19 Aug – 9 Nov
